text: ‘Modernisation theory offers the best explanation for global inequality.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Global migration has given people in developing countries more freedom and better life chances.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Media content is influenced mainly by editors and journalists.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Access to the new media has given people more power to challenge existing power structures.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Women are oppressed by religion.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘There is clear evidence that people are less religious today.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
